title: Derived pullback of a perfect complex is perfect
statement: Let $A\to B$ be a ring map and let $K$ be a perfect complex [def-pc-perfect-complex] of $A$-modules. Then $K\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}B$ is a perfect complex [def-pc-perfect-complex] of $B$-modules.
